lines.text: The apostles returned to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives and went to the upper room where they were staying.
The apostles prayed with the women, Mary the mother of Jesus, and His brothers, and Peter stood among about seventy people.
Peter said Judas guided those who arrested Jesus, and Judas bought a field that people called Akeldama, Field of Blood.
Peter said the new man must have been with them from John's baptism until Jesus was taken up, and they proposed Joseph Barsabbas and Silas.
They prayed, cast lots, and the lot fell to Matthias, who was added to the eleven apostles.
